structured_stats.description:
The '''Gatling Gun''' is an advanced [[Towers|tower]] that is able to be placed on both ground and cliffs, which can be controlled by the player using its ability. It can be bought for {{Coins|35,000}} when the player has reached {{Level|175}} or bought for {{Robux|1,364}}.

The '''Gatling Gun''' will fire at any enemy in its range based on its targeting, hitting only one enemy. However, unlike most other towers, its range is actually a circular sector, which gets a larger angle with upgrades. When an enemy gets out of its range, it will not follow it, even if it could technically reach it if it moved. The '''Gatling Gun''' also has a limited amount of ammo. Every shot loses one ammo; it will not reload until it runs out of ammo; after that, it will take a few seconds for it to reload.

Its ''FPS'' (''<u>f</u>irst-<u>p</u>erson <u>s</u>hooter'') ability allows the player to control the '''Gatling Gun''', which changes how the tower is used drastically. Most noticeably, the tower itself will no longer automatically shoot at enemies, and will only do so when the player shoots. The player can also reload at any point while the tower itself only does so when it runs out of ammo. The player does not have to manually reload when the tower runs out of ammo, as that still happens automatically. When firing, the bullets now pierce through enemies. The first two enemies receive full damage, while the third receives halved damage. If the damage is not a whole number, it is rounded up. Additionally, the player is not affected by any range statistics; the player can fire anywhere on the map, even if the '''Gatling Gun''' could not do it on its own. However, unlike the non-controlled '''Gatling Gun''', the player cannot shoot through some obstacles, such as cliffs. Additionally, the player itself is affected by spread and recoil.

The '''Gatling Gun''' itself has flying detection from Level 0 and hidden detection from Level 3. When controlled by the player, it has both of these detections. The '''Gatling Gun''' also cannot be stunned, regardless if it is being controlled or not. It also cannot have debuffs applied to it if the enemy that applies it was added before the [[v1.9.0]] update.

Due to the '''Gatling Gun's''' high base cost, extremely expensive upgrades, and high DPS, it is considered a mid-late game tower due to the placement limit of one. 

There is a limit of one '''Gatling Gun''' per player.

{{BuffInfobox
|name = Damage Debuff
|image = Transparent.png
|type = Debuff
|display = N/A
}}

==Description==
The '''Damage Debuff''' is a debuff applied by enemies that decreases a tower's damage. This debuff does not appear anywhere on the tower, though it does reduce the percentage of the tower's [[Damage Buff]].

==Mechanics==
The '''Damage Debuff''' effectively is just a negative [[Damage Buff]], best seen if a tower affected by it has a [[Damage Buff]]. For example, if a tower with a 20% [[Damage Buff]] receives a 15% '''Damage Debuff''', the [[Damage Buff]] will get reduced to 5%. Similarly, if a tower receives a '''Damage Debuff''' higher than its current [[Damage Buff]], the icon for it will be removed entirely. For example, if a tower with a 50% [[Damage Buff]] will receive a 60% '''Damage Debuff''', the icon for the buff will disappear and the tower will end up with a 10% '''Damage Debuff'''.

The damage affected by the '''Damage Debuff''' is calculated as:
::<big>'''Damage × (1 - (Damage Debuff - [[Damage Buff]]))'''</big>
:::where '''Damage Debuff''' and [[Damage Buff]] is the debuff supplied by the enemy in decimal form (for example, 10% is 0.1). If the tower has no [[Damage Buff]] on itself, the number for it should be set to 0.

The damage of a tower affected by the '''Damage Debuff''' cannot be in decimal form, instead of being rounded down or rounded up to the nearest integer. For example, a tower that deals 5 damage with a 50% '''Damage Debuff''' will deal 2 damage, instead of 2.5. The damage also cannot be lower than 1. For example, a tower with a 25% debuff will have its damage displayed as 0.75, but it will actually deal 1 damage, though some towers like the [[Shotgunner]] will break and actually deal nan damage.

==Applied By==
The following event enemies can apply the '''Damage Debuff''' to towers:
*[[Null Missile APC]] (''Null Missile Barrage'' ability, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
*[[Null Pursuit]] (''Missile Attack'' ability, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
*[[Rift Walker]] (''Dimensional Discharge'' ability, [[Null & Void Event|Null & Void]])
*[[Missile Ducky]] (''Widespread Terrorism'' ability, [[Ducky Revenge Event|Ducky Revenge]])

==Description==
The '''Golden Minigunner''' is a golden perk for the [[Minigunner]], obtained from the [[Golden Crate]] for {{Coins|50,000}} if you own the [[Minigunner]]. It can also be bought in the [[Daily Store]] for {{Coins|75,000}}.

Before the '''Golden Minigunner''' starts firing, it needs to rev up its minigun. If there are no enemies in its range while revved-up, it will wait for around a second for an enemy to enter its range. If no enemy enters its range in that time, it begins to deactivate the gun and will need to rev the gun up again when an enemy enters its range. It fires bullets at enemies at a fast firerate. The '''Golden Minigunner''' has high DPS and a relatively cheap cost compared to other high DPS towers, like the [[Accelerator]] or [[Engineer]]. 

The '''Golden Minigunner''' has more damage and costs more than its normal counterpart, the [[Minigunner]], making it a direct upgrade in many ways. It is mostly considered a mid-game to late-game tower, although it can be used in early game if you have enough base health and focus solely on using the [[Farm]] for some time.

Burst |ranged_damage = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Damage]]4 |burst = [[File:Damage Icon.png|20px|Burst]]6 |ranged_firerate = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Firerate]]0.2 |cooldown = [[File:Cooldown Icon.png|20px|Cooldown]]1 |ranged_range = [[File:Range Icon.png|20px|Range]]22 |speed = 4 |hidden = {{Attr|Hidden|Level 0+}} |lead = {{Attr|Lead|Level 0+}} (Collision only) |flying = {{Attr|Flying|Level 1}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Gunner Elf''' is one of the final units that spawns from the [[Elf Camp]]. It spawns when the [[Elf Camp]] is at Level 3-4, replacing the [[Cannoneer Elf]]. As with other [[units]], it starts from the end of the map path and moves towards the entrance of the map. It has a spawnrate of 30 seconds. The '''Gunner Elf''' fires in bursts of 6. Whenever there are enemies in its range, the '''Gunner Elf''' will stop moving and attack enemies with its snowball launcher. As the snowballs fired by it are a projectile, they may not hit the intended target but a different enemy instead or miss an enemy entirely. It will continue walking when there are no enemies left in its range. Two '''Gunner Elves''' spawn each time starting from Level 4. These are not one unit, but two units. ==Appearance== The '''Gunner Elf''' has dark skin and brown hair. It wears a green shirt with a brown belt and red details, green and red hat with golden stars and goggles on top, dark green pants and brown shoes. It wields a snowball cannon that it attacks enemies with. ==Statistics== {{neow| $DPS$ = (Damage * Burst Count) / (Cooldown + (Firerate * Burst Count)) $RAM$ = Health / Spawnrate $REF$ = DPS is calculated as (Damage × Burst Count) ÷ (Cooldown + (Firerate × Burst Count)).

Ram DPS |- | 0 || 40 || 4 || 6 || 30 || 0.2 || 1 || 22 || 4 || $DPS$ || $RAM$ |- | 1 || 50 || 6 || 6 || 30 || 0.2 || 1 || 25 || 4 || $DPS$ || $RAM$ |}

Each one will go down a random path. *The '''Gunner Elf''' has hidden and flying detections, making them quite useful against such enemies. **The '''Gunner Elf''' cannot collide with [[Ghost (Attribute)|Ghost]] enemies like [[Soul]]s, but it can attack them. *The '''Gunner Elf''' can deal full collision damage to enemies with defense, like the [[Heavy]] or [[Elite Abnormal]]. **Its gun damage is still affected. *The '''Gunner Elf''' is not affected by any buff or debuff. *The '''Gunner Elf''' will struggle against any enemy with abilities that damage units because of its low health. **For example, if the [[Fallen King]] uses its ''Sword Swing'' attack, and a '''Gunner Elf''' is caught in the attack, it will die instantly regardless of how much health it has. ==Trivia== *The '''Gunner Elf''' is the first unit to have hidden detection. ==Update History== {{scroll|text = *'''21 December 2022''' - [[v1.6.0]] **'''Gunner Elf''' added. **{{Bug}} Firing sound is not affected by the [[Settings#Towers|Towers]] sound setting. *''

==Description==
The '''Minigun Sentry''', internally referred to as '''Sentry3''', is the third sentry that is spawned by the [[Engineer]], that spawns when the [[Engineer]] is at Level 4. Instead of spawning on the path, it spawns on the ground in the [[Engineer]]'s sentry placement range. It takes about 1.75 seconds to build the '''Minigun Sentry'''.

Before the '''Minigun Sentry''' starts firing, it needs to rev-up its miniguns. The rev-up time is 1.5 seconds. When the [[Engineer]] that created it is at Level 5, the '''Minigun Sentry''' has a shield. This shield prevents the '''Minigun Sentry''' from being damaged by any enemy's ability. This shield is only active when the [[Engineer]] itself is not stunned.

There is a limit of three units per [[Engineer]] when it is at Level 4, limiting the amount of '''Minigun Sentries''' it can spawn.

==Appearance==
The '''Minigun Sentry''' is a quadpod device constructed out of metal, colored black and white. It is a sentry that uses a mounted minigun to attack enemies, which spins when attacking enemies. It has a red laser mounted on top. It also has a red shield, which dissapears when the [[Engineer]] that spawned the '''Minigun Sentry''' is stunned.
